column1: # The game's GameDataMgr, which the host reads for the Discord presence (dm/host/gamedata.c, dm/host/presence.c; the game's note, "Discord presence").
# Mapped by sloperinaGZ on both builds (its docs/FINDINGS.md, sections 4 and 9.17, and z64hd_builds.h); checked by this host on 1.0.0 (the note).
# game.py header writes it into game_profile.h (DM_GAME_GD_BUILDS, DM_GAME_GD_TYPES, DM_GAME_GD_FIELDS, DM_GAME_GD_MENUS). Rows, tab-separated:
#   build    <main build ID> <slot> <vtable>     main + slot holds a pointer to the holder of the manager; main + vtable is the vtable of its first type entry
#   entries  <first> <step> <vtable step>        type entry n at manager + first + step * n, n the save file's type number (0 Bool, 2 Int, ...), its vtable
#                                                vtable step * n past the first's. An entry: vtable +0, field count (u32) +0x08, objects +0x10, hash table +0x18
#                                                ((hash, index) pairs, probed from hash % size; hash 0 is a free slot), the table's size (u32) +0x24
#   type     <name> <number> <stride> <value>    object i at objects + i * stride, its current value at + value. A text (String64): a pointer to the text
#                                                and its capacity (u32). A text array (String64Array): a count (u64) and a pointer to the elements, each a text
#   field    <role> <type> <name or hash>        a field the presence reads: its full name (MurmurHash3, seed 0) or, for a field no name is known for, its hash
#   menu     <role> <name>                       a value of the menu field, an enum (MurmurHash3 of the value's name)
# element 0 of this array is the place the Load screen shows (caption.sav's location): KokiriForest, LakeHylia, ...; empty at the title screen
# the game's own pause: its pause screen and item menus (the menu field moves through other values during a load too)
# seconds: loaded from the save, it counts on in play; between two saves it grew by the wall-clock time between them
